ai.title: Codemap parser caching and export statement support
ai.summary: The `getLanguageConfig` function now lazily initializes and caches tree-sitter `Parser` and `Query` instances within the language configuration object, preventing redundant instantiation during file parsing. The TypeScript tags query file (`tree-sitter-typescript-tags.scm`) was updated to capture identifiers from `export_statement` declarations for both `lexical_declaration` and `variable_declaration`. This change removes the global parser instance from `parse.ts` and deletes the unused `typescript-query.scm` file. Scope is limited to the `common/src/codemap` subsystem.

eli5.text: When the code-reading tool looks at files, it used to rebuild its reading engine every single time it opened a file, which slowed things down. Now it builds the engine once, saves it, and reuses it for all the files it reads. At the same time, it got better at spotting names in files that are set aside to be shared with other parts of a project, specifically, names written as exported constants and exported variables, so they show up correctly in the generated map of your code. These engine improvements happen automatically behind the scenes when you ask the tool to analyze your codebase.
